description: Angular component for managing entity aliases in a dialog interface, including form controls, widget associations, and validation logic.

classes.name: EntityAliasesDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and editing entity aliases within a dialog, with form validation, widget association, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: addWidgetTitleToWidgetsMap
methods.description: Associates widget titles with entity alias IDs for display purposes.

methods.name: createEntityAliasFormControl
methods.description: Creates a form control for an entity alias with validation and reactive updates.

methods.name: entityAliasesFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of entity alias controls.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state for validation display.

methods.name: removeAlias
methods.description: Removes an entity alias from the form, with checks for widget associations.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new entity alias.

methods.name: editAlias
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an existing entity alias.

methods.name: openAliasDialog
methods.description: Handles opening the alias editing/adding dialog and updating the form upon completion.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the entity aliases, dispatching error notifications if needed.
